note: RicksClips3000 story Shorts, audio measured 2026-11-02 on the Mac (Demucs htdemucs_ft stems, research/music/tools/story_sound.py + analyze.py + motion_spikes.py + story_sound_summary.py). Only the 8 references with an audio track on the Spark (refs/ig/ricks720_*.webm, the PARITY 8) are measured: the 16 others in refs/lanes/ricks/vid are video-only downloads. Numbers only; no audio, words or stems leave ~/faceless-work/ricks-sound.

method.gap: momentary (0.4 s) loudness, voice stem minus music bed (non-voice stem with detected SFX frames interpolated over), under speech (analyze.py speech mask)
method.sfx: events in the Demucs drums stem rising >= 6 dB over their 2.5 s rolling median in >= 25 % of the audible mel bands (or >= 8 dB in half the bands < 300 Hz); kinds by duration/attack/centroid/harmonicity. Validated on our Turk mix against its cue list: crisp SFX found, soft long swells and quiet ticks missed, so ref counts are lower bounds; tonal SFX that Demucs files under 'other' are missed
method.level_vs_voice: peak 100 ms loudness of the event minus the voice's median momentary loudness in speech
method.sync: share of SFX onsets within 0.3 s of a visual change (frame_metrics transitions + cuts, 240p) or 0.2 s of a motion onset (motion_spikes.py), vs a 2000-shift circular null
method.room: speech gaps >= 120 ms from a 20 ms voice mask; vocals stem and full mix RMS in the gaps re speech RMS
method.voice: pYIN f0 60-400 Hz; crest = peak/RMS per 0.5 s speech window; LTAS bands re total 50 Hz-16 kHz
method.groups: top = views rank <= 8 of the 24 RicksClips Shorts; rest = the other measured refs

ours_labels.ab_B: A/B side B: Turk voice + audio profile story_ricks (Demucs); side A = turk_v7 (bit-identical remix)
ours_labels.ab_B_tight: side B with the profile's pause tightening applied to the cached voice (Demucs)
ours_labels.ab_B_tight_true: side B tightened, our own stems
ours_labels.ab_B_true: A/B side B, our own stems
ours_labels.turk_v7_true: story-chess-turk current mix, our own stems
ours_labels.vasa_v1_true: story-vasa v1 mix, our own stems
